blocks.text: DNA replication is the process in which a DNA molecule makes an identical copy (replica) of itself. DNA is a double helix of two strands, so both strands are copied.

blocks.title: Recalling
blocks.text: The DNA in chromatids replicates so that chromatids can duplicate. This happens before a cell divides, during the S-phase of interphase.

blocks.prompt: In which phase of the cell cycle does DNA replicate?
blocks.explanation: In the S-phase of interphase, before the cell divides.

items: Replication: DNA copies both strands of its double helix, in the S-phase.
